question: Which country hosted the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 took place from 11 to 30 October 2022 across three venues: **Bhubaneswar, Goa, and Navi Mumbai**.
 
• This was India's** first time** hosting the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
 
• The event saw participation from **16 teams**, and Spain emerged as the champion, defending their title from the previous edition held in 2018.
